about_the_game:
Stormlander is a new-style online action game that lets up to 100 players enjoy intense siege battles.

Work together with your allies to dominate close combat and break through a castle using siege weapons like battering rams.

The team that destroys the core inside the enemy castle wins.

A fusion of innovative game genres

Stormlander is a PvP action game that combines elements from a number of different games.

Experience high-speed battles packed with action like never before, including MOBA tactics, shooter techniques, and the depth and exhilaration of close combat.

Ever-changing battle conditions

The battle conditions are constantly changing, with character growth, terrain changes, and the appearance of Apocalyptic spells with overwhelming destructive power.

Experience battlefields of varying scales and weaponry, including 20 vs. 20 vs. 20 vs. 20 vs. 20 five-team battles, 20 vs. 20 mode, and 12 vs. 12 mode.

To excel in any situation, accumulating knowledge and experience across various battlefields is the first step toward victory.

 Play with friends

Form a party of up to four players and charge through the battlefield together.

If you don't want to join a pre-made party, you can coordinate with teammates via in-game voice chat, and share strategies as a team.

Play your own way

Use Warrior, Cleric, and Mage with different strengths and powerful skills to break through difficult situations.

Customize your characters' skills and equipment to create the ideal hero that suits your play style.

Once you've created your favorite character, you can change their hairstyle and equipment to make them truly your own.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 @3.00 GHz / AMD FX-6300 Six-Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 960, 4GB / Radeon RX 560, 4GB
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 @ 3.20Ghz / AMD Ryzen 7 2700
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060, 6 GB / Radeon RX 5700 XT, 8 GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
